title: Kairos scaffold-binding archetype catalog entry
description: One EntityBinding scaffold shape consumed by `kairos-ontology scaffold-binding`. Distinct from, and not coupled to, the DD-090 business-discovery concept-archetype catalog (core/archetype_loader.py) -- only the versioned-catalog-plus-loader shape is shared in spirit.

grainMode.description: 'derive' computes grain.columns from Bronze metadata; 'sentinel' emits an obviously-invalid placeholder a human must confirm (grain is one of the three things scaffold-binding never silently guesses).

grainHintMode.description: When grainMode is 'sentinel', an optional richer sentinel that embeds detected candidate column names as a hint without using them as the real grain (still invalid, still confirmation-gated).

identityMode.description: 'derive' reuses the derived grain as identity.sourceKey (passthrough only); 'sentinel' emits a placeholder identity key a human must confirm.

loadMode.description: Fixed at 'full-refresh' for every archetype in this catalog version: 'incremental' requires 14 additional operational sub-fields (CDC column/values, watermark columns, lookback policy, ...) that cannot be safely defaulted without human input for any archetype, including event-stream. Authors upgrade to incremental by hand once those are known.

scaffoldConformance.description: Emit a sentinel conformance: block (merged-master only) -- survivorship policy is never silently guessed.

scaffoldRelationshipExample.description: Emit a sentinel DD-138 externalReference relationships: entry as a worked, heavily-commented example (line-item-child only).

promotableFrom.description: Archetype ids this archetype's fields: may be seeded from via --from-binding.
